description: Learner-matched shared balance sheet (CANDIDATES CH258, development only): LightGBM with se1_lgbm_mm's params on the champion's features + the stress aux family (se-aux-stress-v1: BTC 1 h realised volatility from the crypto family's stored 1m klines, its ratio to the 7-day and to the same-clock-hour baselines, the stress flag ratio >= 2, BTC 2 h return and its size, ETH 1 h realised volatility) + the slotfac family (se-aux-slotfac-v1: the previous slot's non-crypto mean |2 h change|, the common-factor control). Slot-level columns, all closed before the capture start. Read against se1_lgbm_mm, the gain is stress plus its control; none of it is credited to BTC / ETH stress before a slotfac-only reference arm is read (DESIGN_V1 section 36). Trains only when every labelled capture of the window has both tables; not embargoed.
